title: Apple Jam
description: Adds inventory jam (buffering keys while having a menu open) to macOS
body: # Apple Jam This is a very simple mod designed to do one thing: **add inventory jam support to macOS.** ### What is "Inventory Jam"? [According to the Minecraft Parkour Wiki](https://www.mcpk.wiki/wiki/Hotkey_Exploits), inventory jamming is _opening the inventory, holding Forward + Jump, then closing the inventory to consistently perform a 0-tick timing (jam)._ This is vanilla game behavior on Windows and Linux (in most cases). Unfortunately, it does not work on macOS, which can make things more difficult for parkour enthusiasts on a Mac. This mod fixes that, allowing you to enjoy it too :3
